additional_info.subject: Translate of reported issue / Behaviour
additional_info.body:
This ticket follows ticket ID0380252.
The door is still hard to open / impossible to open. There were 2 of us there, and even 2 of us were unable to open the door. When leaving the station, the door was stuck and the terminal was available. Since yesterday, the door detector indicates that the door is open. This is certainly due to the door contact being fragile or the door not being stuck properly.
I don't have a photo because there were no visual signs on site + we were unable to open the door.
I'm not going back to the site because there's not much I can do if I can't open the door

Hello RC-FR Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / P7 312547889/08
Charger ID/Serial No.:
sPWpLI
Problem Description:
The door is still hard to open / impossible to open
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
20th Oct. 2024
, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
The customer has reported that the door is difficult or impossible to open. Two people attempted to open the door but were unsuccessful. The customer believes the issue may be due to a fragile door contact or improper alignment of the door. Please plan a site visit to inspect the charger door lock and investigate the issue further.
Additional Note:
A case (0380252) was previously closed for this charger with a similar issue after replacing a door system block / connector door cable, and the report was shared with the customer. However, after the case was closed, the customer replied that the address mentioned in the report may not be correct. Kindly validate the earlier service to ensure the correct unit was addressed in the previous ticket.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
